purpose: Resume post-verification visible game construction with low-cost movement and fauna that make traversal feel more alive without changing story, save, route or chapter topology.

movement_profiles.behavior: 3D point-to-point flight with bounded pitch/roll body motion
ground point-to-point travel with bounded hop/rest rhythm
slow 3D flutter with small local oscillation

story_safety: Fauna never owns quest state or persistent transforms.
Moria remains civilian/fauna-empty under the dead-city rule.
Caradhras ambient life is weather/party-authored only; no resident or fauna actors are spawned by LivingWorldDirector.
Anduin/Amon Hen baseline uses fauna only and never invents civilians around the Fellowship break.
performance_rules: Reuse the existing AShireAmbientNPC distance-throttled tick path.
Spawn fauna only inside existing bounded micro-events.
No skeletal meshes, navmesh crowd simulation or physics are required for CP55 fauna.
All fauna are disposable and cleaned by the existing LivingWorldDirector event cull path.
Target remains Windows DX11 1280x720 Low-Medium with a 30 FPS floor.

implemented: bird flight, rabbit hop and butterfly flutter movement
fauna excluded from NPC social pairing
not_claimed: final target-device performance acceptance for CP55
